description: This file defines the QueryParser class responsible for parsing XML-based query responses from AWS services, such as EC2 and SQS. It provides methods to parse XML responses and handle result wrappers, integrating with AWS SDK components.

classes.name: QueryParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling AWS query-style (XML) responses, including peeling wrappers and parsing specific XML structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with the AWS service description, optional XML parser, and wrapper handling flag.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Parses an AWS command response, extracting the relevant XML and returning a Result object.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a specific member of the response directly from a stream using the configured XML parser.
